basic_info.description: Charming and Versatile Coastal Home - 1 Block from the Beach!    This captivating property offers a vacant two-level owner's unit filled with character and comfort. The main floor features an elegant living room with a cozy fireplace, a spacious bedroom, a full bath, and a bright eat-in kitchen.      Upstairs, a charming, nautically inspired space with its own bath awaits - ideal for a family room, luxurious master suite, child's room, office, or artist's retreat with ocean views.    The legal lower garden apartment. Both units vacant.  Disclosures: https://app.disclosures.io/link/24432445-47th-Avenue-jxf39lmm  Reviewing offers Tuesday 2/18/2025 @ Noon.  Please email offers to Listing Agent rfleischer@amsiemail.com.  Please included receipt for disclosure package and verification of funds with offer.
